É o cenário ideal para quem busca mais do que um cargo: busca crescimento, impacto e propósito. Missão Estruturar, priorizar e gerenciar o portfólio de projetos estratégicos da empresa, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de crescimento, profissionalização da gestão e aumento da eficiência operacional. Estruturar projetos de ponta a ponta, definindo escopo, objetivos, cronograma, orçamento, indicadores de sucesso, responsáveis e plano de riscos. Manter o portfólio corporativo atualizado, assegurando visibilidade sobre prioridades, status, recursos e responsáveis. Promover a cultura de experimentação e validação rápida de hipóteses por meio de MVPs, pilotos e testes controlados. Aplicar metodologias de Growth e melhoria contínua, conduzindo ciclos de experimentação, priorização e aprendizado. Conduzir projetos utilizando práticas ágeis (Kanban, Scrum, Sprints) integradas aos princípios tradicionais de gestão de projetos. Apoiar a tomada de decisão baseada em dados, monitorando e analisando KPIs, OKRs e indicadores de geração de valor para o negócio. Acompanhar prazos, custos, escopo e qualidade das entregas, identificando desvios e implementando ações corretivas. Gerenciar riscos, dependências e impedimentos que possam comprometer os resultados dos projetos. Desenvolver dashboards, relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas para acompanhamento da liderança e diretoria. Identificar gargalos operacionais e liderar iniciativas que aumentem produtividade, controle e capacidade de escala da empresa. Atuar como facilitador da transformação cultural, apoiando a adoção de metodologias, processos e ferramentas de gestão. Organizar reuniões de acompanhamento, comitês e fóruns executivos, registrando decisões, responsabilidades e planos de ação. Padronizar processos, templates, rituais e metodologias de gestão de projetos, promovendo governança e captura de lições aprendidas. Garantir elevado padrão de execução, acompanhamento e cobrança das entregas, contribuindo para a profissionalização da organização. Influenciar gestores e áreas da empresa na priorização de iniciativas estratégicas e na busca por resultados mensuráveis. Requisitos Formação acadêmica Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos, Economia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Estratégia, Processos, Negócios ou áreas relacionadas será considerada um diferencial. Vivência em ambientes de crescimento, reestruturação, profissionalização ou implementação de processos. Histórico comprovado de condução de projetos estratégicos com impacto em resultados de negócio. Experiência com metodologias ágeis e gestão baseada em indicadores.

review_candidates.description: SOVOS Senior Technical Support Analyst Sovos·Full-Time·Brazil Build Your Future With Us The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive. AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. The Role At Sovos, we're building solutions that help businesses navigate the complexities of tax and regulatory compliance across the globe. As a Senior SAP ABAP Support Analyst, you'll be a technical expert diagnosing issues with Sovos e-invoicing and compliance solutions running inside customer SAP environments (ECC and S/4HANA). You'll combine the ability to read, debug, and trace ABAP code with SAP FI and/or SD functional knowledge to find the root cause of problems for enterprise customers, then route each case to the right team for resolution. More Specifically, You Will Handle escalated, complex technical support cases that require deep product knowledge, ABAP debugging, and advanced troubleshooting in customer SAP systems. Diagnose application defects, integration failures, performance issues, and production incidents, performing technical root-cause analysis across SAP, XML, middleware, tax engines, and government interfaces. Determine whether each issue is a core product problem or a customer-specific customization or configuration problem, and hand it off to Product/Engineering or Professional Services with a clear, documented diagnosis. Trace fiscal and tax data from SAP SD, MM, and FI documents through to the generated electronic fiscal documents, identifying where data, configuration, or logic breaks the process. Debug and trace ABAP code, analyze dumps, application logs, and job logs to identify the root cause of issues in customer SAP systems, and troubleshoot SAP interfaces (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, ALE, SOAP Web Services, REST APIs, OData) used in e-invoicing and fiscal integrations. Analyze and validate XML-based electronic documents against their schemas, including Brazilian fiscal XML structures, to diagnose transformation and data errors, and leverage AI-assisted tools to improve the efficiency and quality of diagnostics. Collaborate with Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and customer stakeholders to resolve cases, communicate diagnoses clearly, and support customers during testing, go-live, hyper-care, rollouts, releases, and patches. Create and maintain knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides, identify recurring issues, share trends and recommendations, and mentor colleagues through hands-on guidance. What You Bring to Sovos You've built solid experience in SAP ABAP debugging, performance analysis, and troubleshooting in ECC and/or S/4HANA environments. You have strong functional knowledge of SAP FI and/or SD modules, including how fiscal and tax data flows through business documents. You bring deep knowledge of Brazilian fiscal localization and electronic fiscal documents (NF-e, NFS-e, CT-e), and understand how they integrate with SAP systems and government authorities. You're skilled in troubleshooting SAP interfaces (IDoc, RFC, BAPI, ALE, SOAP Web Services, REST APIs, OData) and XML-based data structures and transformations. You have a track record of diagnosing complex, mission-critical issues for enterprise customers and communicating technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You're comfortable with AI-assisted workflows and tools to enhance diagnostic efficiency and quality. Fluent Portuguese and working English proficiency required. The Process We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 1 Pre-Employment Assessment Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 2 Video Interview A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 3 Meeting with a Recruiter A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 4 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. Life at Sovos The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside! Global Mentoring Programs AI Tools and Technology from Day 1 Continuous Learning and Development Language Learning Support Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs Global Parental Leave Policy Comprehensive Medical and Dental Plan Life Insurance Meal/Food Card Wellness Platform Childcare Reimbursement Benefit Equal Opportunity Employer Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Company Background Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com. The Director of Training is responsible successfully on-board, skill and develop the hotel team through well designed and operationally viable blended learning solutions and ensure that every corporate training initiative has been successfully implemented and each hotel employee is to developed in both skills and competencies to deliver a consistent beautiful performance that creates a signature differentiation for our brand in the luxury hotel segment, and further positioning Kempinski as the employer of choice. Key Responsibilities The job of The Director of Training is executed satisfactorily when: All employees receive both Kempinski and locally required training. The hotel implements the 70-20-10 training strategy and ensures that the hotel achieves the company key performance indicators for training engagement. Achieve Kempinski training engagement rate. The training calendar and the business plan reflect Kempinski training guidelines and the internal training needs analysis. Ensure that all Regional and Corporate reporting responsibilities are fulfilled in line with the corporate reporting guidelines The hotel utilises all Kempinski Training tools including F! & E! Training programmes, Leadership Development Programme and all On-Line learning opportunities. Every department has Departmental Trainer(s), departmental policies and procedures and have fully implemented the Kempinski on-job training tools such as Training BITES Kempinski Experience Assessment meets or exceeds the company benchmark. Enhance Employee Engagement rate, which is reflected annually in the Kempinski Employee Engagement Survey. Enhance hotel Guest Satisfaction Survey results. Employee relationship and recognition programme(s) are in place. Kempinski training policies and procedures are fully implemented and complied with. Ensure that every new employee is correctly on-boarded and has received a comprehensive brand emersion using the designated on-boarding training packages. They actively support and implement Talent Development initiatives as a part of their daily activities. They identify Training talents in their department and throughout the hotel as per below definition* and actively support their career development. They support and initiate transfer, cross exposure and task force assignments for their team. They personally conduct performance appraisal with their team on a regular basis and take personal interest for their talents’ development plans. They recruit and select potential talent according to current and future department, hotel and Kempinski’s needs including conducting interviews for positions in their department. *A Hotel Talent is an employee, who has the ability to do the current job in their hotel and can be promoted to the next level. Mobility is what makes this person a Kempinski Talent. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Establish a training network according to Kempinski standard, including spending time in operations to foster this network. Analyse training needs and training effectiveness. Ensure that every department having corporately developed Training BITES have fully implemented these, and ensured they reflect all hotel specific policies and procedures Further develop the Training BITE Library by assisting individual Departmental Trainers in the writing and implementing hotel specific training BITES Embed all Kempinski training programs and training tools and comprehensively track their implementation to easily evaluate attendance of required participants. Plan, design and deliver training programmes. Devise a training marketing strategy, which is evident both at the back of house and reflected in campaigns or initiatives to address training topics/themes accordingly. Analyse the data on the e-learning platforms and utilize or market it to Management and Department Trainers to enhance learning performance. Coach and train managers and Departmental Trainers to improve departmental performance. Works with the General Manager to coordinate relevant learning for EXCOM and HODs as per their Individual Development Program. Organise and supervise Kempinski DNA and brand immersion activities. Continuously seek and support new approaches, practices and processes to improve the efficiency of the training services offered. Work together with department heads and analyse operational quality performance using the Kempinski Experience Assessment Tool (KEA) and ReviewPro; then based on the results provide remedial training solution. Train and develop Training team members. Complete Kempinski Experience Assessment (KEA) Checks as specified by the hotel management Identify potential training talent and propose & foster Master Trainer candidates. Ensure that the Kempinski Training Monthly report is correctly completed on a monthly basis and the results updated in the Regional Training Consolidation Report In absence of a Training Coordinator, ensure that the responsibilities are fulfilled. Lead by example and promote Kempinski’s core values. Prepare the yearly Business Plan and Budget for the Training Department in line with all company Brand Standards together with the Heads of Department and ExCom team. Ensure that an objective Self Audit (using the Kempinski People Training Peer & Self Audit Tool) is completed at least once per year Promote and implement Kempinski Corporate Training policies and procedures. Establish and foster relationships and partnerships with external suppliers, training providers, and legal and safety entities.
